name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's fascination with motorsport began during his youth, tinkering with go-karts in his hometown. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in simulation and modeling. After graduating, he worked on developing simulation software for industrial applications, but his heart always remained in motorsport. He joined a small sim racing team to gain experience and network within the racing community. 

Krzysztof is known for his pragmatic approach to problem-solving. He values data and thorough analysis, always seeking to improve the accuracy and realism of the simulator. He is eager to learn from experienced engineers and contribute his skills to a successful racing team. He is particularly interested in developing driver-in-the-loop simulations and enhancing the feedback systems for driver training.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a sturdy build and often wears glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workspace at the end of each day.
Always drinks herbal tea during work to stay focused.
